397 B in 57 pieces of 18 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
103 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (51 packages, 1,030 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
